name: Kuakata
summary: One of the few beaches where you can watch both sunrise and sunset over the sea. Wide, flat sand, Buddhist temples and mangrove villages.
season_note: November to March is dry and comfortable. Cyclone season (April to May, October to November) can bring storms.
avoid_note: Check cyclone warnings before you go. The sea can be rough in the monsoon.

reach.how: AC coach from Dhaka (Gabtoli, Sayedabad) via Barishal or ferry - Saudia, Green Line, Hanif
reach.note: Long overnight travel; ferry crossing times vary.

reach.how: Overnight launch Dhaka-Barishal (Sadarghat) then bus to Kuakata

attractions.name: Sunrise and sunset on the beach
attractions.what: See the sun rise and set over the sea from the same beach.
attractions.tip: Wake up before dawn. Walk on the beach.

attractions.name: Rakhine Buddhist Temple and Buddha statue
attractions.what: A temple and a large Buddha statue with a local Rakhine community.

attractions.name: Gangamati Mangrove Forest
attractions.what: A calm mangrove area for boat rides.

attractions.name: Rakhine handloom market
attractions.what: Cloth and handicrafts from the Rakhine community.

attractions.name: Fisherman's market (Alipur dry fish)
attractions.what: Walk through the dry-fish yards and the fish market.
attractions.tip: Strong smell; go for the colours and the boats.

rules: Swim only where locals say it is safe.
Check the weather bulletin before the trip.
